fieldData.full-article-text:
To ensure greater functionality and a secure P2P connection with your new Babylon wallet V 1.0, it is suggested that you link the Radix wallet to your desktop. To do this, you will need to install Radix Connect for Chrome.

You can start the installation process at https://wallet.radixdlt.com.

Click Install Radix Connector for Chrome or click Opening the linking QR code. 

Go to the Chrome store and click Add to Chrome, grant permissions, and add it to Chrome.
Once this has been done, click Open the Linking QR Code on the wallet setup page. A QR code will appear on the screen. This is safe to scan; it contains no sensitive information. 

Once added, open the mobile App settings and click Link to Connector 

The mobile app will now display a QR code scanner window, and the desktop will display a QR code.
Scan the QR code displayed on the desktop using the mobile QR code scanner. 
Once the scan is complete, Name the new connector.

You have now successfully linked the Babylon wallet with the Radix Connect desktop extension.

‍

Reminder: Be wary of any unsolicited messages claiming to be from support. There is no customer support via direct messages. Anyone offering to help you resolve a problem via DM will be a scammer. Under no circumstances should you ever share your seed phrases with anyone. Your seed phrases are the keys to your crypto holdings, and keeping them private is paramount for security. Always remain cautious in crypto to safeguard your assets from scams.
fieldData.name: How to Install and Use Radix Connect
